test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

My mother asked me to bring a glass of water for her.

options.text: My mother requested me, "Please, bring a glass of water for me."
My mother ordered me, "Bring a glass of water for her."
My mother said to me, "Bring a glass of water for me."
My mother said to me, "Bring a glass of water for her."

solution:
The correct answer is: **My mother said to me, "Bring a glass of water for me."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is an indirect speech and we need to convert it into direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to a direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reported verb 'asked' changes to 'said to' in the reporting speech part.
 
• The preposition 'to' is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech part.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letter.
 
• The pronoun 'me' in the indirect part changes to 'her' in the direct speech part.
 
 

Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.

Hence, direct speech is - *My mother said to me, "Bring a glass of water for me."*
